Messages.Author: Tom Wylie
Messages.Body:
Nicholas J. Leon <nicholas@tao.binary9.com> wrote:
>This is about the Jyhad card "Trap". Does this card mean:
>1) Three rounds of combat pass in which NO CARDS may be played
>   or
>2) Combat doesn't end UNTIL three rounds have passed in which no cards HAVE
>BEEN played?

2.5)  If any cards have been played within the last three rounds, then the
round has a press to continue.  This press can be offset normally with a
press to end...  which could then be offset with a press to continue...
which would thus start another three rounds of the Trap  :)
